Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.assistance

Interface IAssistanceService

All Known Implementing Classes:
AssistanceService
@Service public interface IAssistanceService
Interface for Assistance Service. Provides method for help menu requests and to get User by its pseudonym from the User Repository.
